title: FINEST: Improving LLM Responses to Sensitive Topics Through Fine-Grained Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Automated evaluation using the FINEST taxonomy to identify 'Non-inclusive (social group)' errors, where model responses fail to respect human diversity or reinforce prejudices against specific groups.

Automated evaluation using the FINEST taxonomy to identify 'Non-inclusive (opinion)' errors, assessing whether the model respects diverse perspectives and avoids taking one-sided stances on controversial or sensitive topics.

Automated evaluation using the FINEST taxonomy to identify 'Social norm violation' errors, specifically checking if responses align with ethical and moral judgments commonly accepted in South Korean society.
Qualitative and automated analysis of model responses to sensitive questions regarding homosexuality and LGBTQ+ rights in Korea, checking for generalizations or negative portrayals.
